coreIdea: Formula of T/F propositions combined with ∧∨¬→↔. Tautology=always T, Contradiction=always F, Satisfiable=T in ≥1 row.
mustRememberFormulas: Contrapositive ¬Q→¬P ≡ P→Q (equivalent); Converse Q→P and Inverse ¬P→¬Q are NOT equivalent to original

patternRecognitionTable.seeThis: 'is this a tautology/contradiction/satisfiable' or truth-value given some propositions
English sentence → formula, or converse/contrapositive asked
premises given, derive conclusion / Modus Ponens / Resolution

commonTrapsQuickList: 'only if' → P→Q, NOT Q→P (most common translation trap)
P→Q vacuously TRUE when P is False
Converse/Inverse ≠ original; only Contrapositive is equivalent
Satisfiable (≥1 True row) ≠ Valid/tautology (ALL True rows)
highYieldPyqLessons: Tautology/contradiction/satisfiability checking is the dominant pattern (21/40) — with ≤3 variables just build the truth table, don't overthink algebra under time pressure.
'Only if' direction is the single most repeated translation trap across decades of GATE papers.
